# Stand-ins

The devnet fixture set's structure, as `scripts/fixtures/localnet.sh` builds it on a local validator (seed root `B6hfkkg1VASB3HP2uwSsQesho7M3ZHNxAaWfJQVAFmxx`), in the `solana account --output json` format. Don't edit by hand.

`cases.json` names the membership rules and, for each account, the rule it is claimed under and whether the rule accepts it: the first pig of each eligible collection passes, and every look-alike fails.
